text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Oh? ...Is nobody here? I could've sworn I 
heard someone calling me.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
—The Three Goddesses,
huh... I wonder just 
how strong they were when they were
active 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
I'll work hard enough to surpass all 
of you. So please watch over me—
